title: Infinity Player PC v2.0.7
changelog: Fixed AudioVault episode streaming so episodes start playing immediately on Enter.

android.title: Infinity Player Android Beta 0.29
android.changelog: 1. Fixed AudioVault online streaming duration, seeking, and auto-relogin. 2. Fixed 'Nothing is ready to play' after pause or network switch (auto-reconnects at saved position). 3. Added local backup & auto-restore for favorites, playlists, and categories. 4. Added 7-day inactivity auto-logout and VPS device session auto-restore on reinstall.
